summary: Selects additional images from a ZED TOP, including depth, color, disparity, normals, point cloud, and spatial texture variants.

key_params.name: toocloseval
key_params.note: Output value for samples too close

key_params.name: toofarval
key_params.note: Output value for samples too far

common_gotchas: Requires a configured and active primary ZED TOP and camera support.
The primary zedtop controls the camera/device configuration; this node selects companion outputs.
Depth outputs use special values for too-close, too-far, and unknown samples; account for these before analysis.
Point-cloud and normal outputs are data images and may need float-preserving downstream formats.
The official page only lists left and right perspective ids, not a combined perspective option.
key_concepts: ZED Select TOP selects additional image outputs from a primary ZED TOP.
The zedtop parameter points to the primary ZED TOP, which must remain active and owns camera/device configuration.
Image selection can expose companion outputs such as depth, confidence, disparity, normals, point cloud, and spatial texture.
Depth-oriented outputs can rerange valid depth and assign explicit values for too-close, too-far, and unknown samples.
